name: F3: schematic edit integrity (click-click Move keeps wires attached)
description: Phase 1 definition-of-done fix F3 (audit defect S4). A fixture project gets two resistors at different heights through the engine's execute_command IPC (SETUP). In the real window the Connect pins tool wires pin 2 of the first part to pin 1 of the second (one ConnectPins). The Move tool then moves the wired part by click-click: the status bar must name one Batch (rubber-band: the wire end follows the pin, so the engine has nothing to warn about), where a bare MoveSymbol used to leave the wire end behind with a warning. Highlight net on the wire then lights both pins (engine netlist), so the wire is still connected at both ends.
